heading: Priorities for our people
intro: The pillars guiding SMA's work in the National Assembly and across the constituency.

items.title: Education
items.text: Scholarships, school renovations and support for teachers so every child in the constituency can learn.

items.title: Healthcare
items.text: Equipping primary health centres and expanding access to maternal and child care.

items.title: Agriculture
items.text: Inputs, mechanisation and market access for farmers across Bida, Gbako and Katcha.

items.title: Youth & Jobs
items.text: Skills acquisition, start-up grants and empowerment programmes for young people and women.

items.title: Infrastructure
items.text: Roads, electrification and clean water projects that connect communities.

items.title: Fiscal Responsibility
items.text: Using his role on the Finance Committee to push for transparent, people-focused budgets.
